## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For visible changes, include a
recording and the platform/renderer used. Explain any checks you could not run.

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] Public API documentation and examples match the change.
- [ ] Accessibility, reduced motion, and compatibility have been considered.
- [ ] The change excludes unrelated files and generated build output.
